source.product: JPL AVIRIS-3 provisional dNBR, NIR 866 nm / SWIR 2198 nm

encoding.red: dNBR clipped to [-0.1, 1.0] -> 1..255 linearly; 0 = no data; dnbr = -0.1 + (R - 1) / 254 * 1.1

georef_check.method: mean distance (cells, capped at 3) from data-edge cells to the final-perimeter boundary, for data shifts up to ±12 cells; offset is [east, south] in cells

notes: Provisional JPL AVIRIS-3 dNBR (866/2198 nm), reprojected bilinearly from 3.1 m UTM 11N to the ~16 m analysis grid. Valid data covers 2.0% of the final perimeter (483 of 23,810 acres); the rest is left as no data. Mean dNBR 0.3542 inside vs 0.1533 outside (n=14 edge cells; JPL clipped the product to a burn perimeter). Data edge best matches the perimeter edge at offset [0, 0] cells (78% of edge cells within 1 cell). severity.png: R = dNBR [-0.1, 1.0] -> 1..255 (0 = no data); G = class 0 none, 1 unburned <0.1, 2 low, 3 moderate-low, 4 moderate-high, 5 high >=0.66. GAP: AVIRIS-3 flight lines miss 98% of the final perimeter; no Sentinel-2 fallback is implemented yet.
